title: Checkout redesign — conversion and payment flow

facts.text: Guest checkout is supported — a shopper can buy without an account
Apple Pay and Google Pay are offered as express options
Address autocomplete on the shipping form
Order summary shows an estimated delivery date before payment
Discount codes can be applied during checkout
A failed card payment is retried up to three times
PCI DSS compliance — card data never stored on our servers
Checkout loads in under two seconds on mid-range mobile over 4G
Orders above 25,000 rupees go to fraud screening or manual review
Saved cards are opt-in and can be deleted by the shopper
The cart persists for 30 days on the same device
Phase one is India-only and priced in Indian rupees
Buy-now-pay-later and a native app checkout are out of scope
Abandoned checkout analytics event to measure the target
